requirements.text: The system shall display the tables that are free for the date, time slot and party size entered by the customer within 2 seconds of the request.
requirements.limitation: Existing source is supporting coverage only; full planned acceptance remains pending.
requirements.candidate: PR #38 (includes #39 merged into its feature branch), not merged to main at baseline; validate separately.

requirements.text: The system shall prevent double-booking by locking a table for its reserved time slot once a booking is confirmed.
requirements.limitation: Existing source is supporting coverage only; full planned acceptance remains pending.
requirements.candidate: PR #38 (includes #39 merged into its feature branch), not merged to main at baseline; validate separately.

requirements.text: The system shall allow a customer to cancel a booking up to 30 minutes before the reserved time, after which the table is released back into the available pool.
requirements.limitation: Existing source is supporting coverage only; full planned acceptance remains pending.

requirements.text: The system shall allow restaurant staff to view, search and manually create or cancel bookings from the admin dashboard.
requirements.limitation: Existing source is supporting coverage only; full planned acceptance remains pending.

requirements.text: The system shall allow an authenticated admin to create, update and delete menu items, including name, description, price, category and availability status.
requirements.limitation: Existing source is supporting coverage only; full planned acceptance remains pending.

requirements.text: The system shall display only menu items marked 'available' to customers browsing the menu or placing an order.
requirements.limitation: Existing source is supporting coverage only; full planned acceptance remains pending.

requirements.text: The system shall assign every menu item to exactly one category (Starters, Main Course, Desserts or Beverages) and display menu items grouped under their category.
requirements.limitation: Existing source is supporting coverage only; full planned acceptance remains pending.

requirements.text: The system shall allow a customer to add one or more available menu items to a cart and submit them as a single order.
requirements.limitation: Existing source is supporting coverage only; full planned acceptance remains pending.

requirements.text: The system shall assign each order a status of Received, Preparing, or Served, and allow staff to update this status.
requirements.limitation: Existing source is supporting coverage only; full planned acceptance remains pending.

requirements.text: The system shall push each order-status change to the customer's order-tracking screen over a WebSocket connection served by the Node.js component within 1 second of the change being saved.
requirements.limitation: Existing source is supporting coverage only; full planned acceptance remains pending.

requirements.text: The system shall reject an order containing a menu item that has since been marked unavailable, and shall notify the customer of which item was removed.
requirements.limitation: Existing source is supporting coverage only; full planned acceptance remains pending.

requirements.text: The system shall allow a customer to register and log in with an email/phone number and a password of at least 8 characters, shall reject an email/phone number that is already registered, and shall store the password only as a salted PBKDF2-SHA256 or Argon2 hash.
requirements.limitation: Email required; optional exact phone login. Phone-only registration decision PENDING-02.

requirements.text: The system shall restrict menu-management functions to users with the Admin role, and booking-override functions (manual create/cancel of any booking) to users with the Admin or Staff role; all other requests shall be denied with HTTP 403.
requirements.limitation: Auth/read ownership guards exist; all feature mutations and pages still require integration.

requirements.text: The system shall invalidate a user's session/token after 30 minutes of inactivity and require the user to log in again.
requirements.limitation: Existing source is supporting coverage only; full planned acceptance remains pending.

requirements.text: Under a load of up to 50 concurrent users, the system shall serve at least 95% of page loads and REST API responses within 2 seconds.
requirements.limitation: Existing source is supporting coverage only; full planned acceptance remains pending.

requirements.text: The system shall deliver at least 95% of WebSocket order-status updates to the customer's screen within 1 second of the status change being saved.
requirements.limitation: Existing source is supporting coverage only; full planned acceptance remains pending.

requirements.text: The system shall support at least 50 concurrent users with an error rate (HTTP 5xx) of no more than 1%.
requirements.limitation: Existing source is supporting coverage only; full planned acceptance remains pending.

requirements.text: The system shall store passwords only as salted PBKDF2-SHA256 or Argon2 hashes, and no plain-text password shall appear in the database or in application logs.
requirements.limitation: Existing source is supporting coverage only; full planned acceptance remains pending.

requirements.text: The system shall serve all pages, REST API endpoints and WebSocket connections over TLS 1.2 or higher (HTTPS/WSS) and shall redirect any HTTP request to HTTPS.
requirements.limitation: HTTPS/WSS deployment and TLS scan not provided.

requirements.text: The system shall enforce role-based access control on every page and API endpoint, returning HTTP 401 to unauthenticated requests and HTTP 403 to authenticated requests whose role is not authorised.
requirements.limitation: Auth/read ownership guards exist; all feature mutations and pages still require integration.

requirements.text: The system shall access the database only through the Django ORM/parameterised queries and shall escape all user-supplied text on output, so that SQL-injection and cross-site-scripting payloads are neither executed nor stored unescaped.
requirements.limitation: Existing source is supporting coverage only; full planned acceptance remains pending.

requirements.text: The system shall reject any state-changing request (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) that lacks a valid CSRF token or authentication token, with HTTP 403.
requirements.limitation: Existing source is supporting coverage only; full planned acceptance remains pending.

requirements.text: The system shall lock a user account for 15 minutes after 5 consecutive failed login attempts.
requirements.limitation: Existing source is supporting coverage only; full planned acceptance remains pending.

requirements.text: The system shall write an audit-log entry (user ID, action, timestamp) for every menu change, staff booking override and order-status change, and retain entries for at least 90 days.
requirements.limitation: Existing source is supporting coverage only; full planned acceptance remains pending.

requirements.text: The system shall set the HttpOnly and Secure flags on session cookies and shall invalidate a session after 30 minutes of inactivity (see REQ-14).
requirements.limitation: Existing source is supporting coverage only; full planned acceptance remains pending.

requirements.text: A first-time customer shall be able to complete a table booking within 3 minutes and no more than 6 page interactions without training.
requirements.limitation: Existing source is supporting coverage only; full planned acceptance remains pending.

requirements.text: The code base shall be divided into separate Django apps for booking, menu, orders and accounts, with no app importing another app's views.
requirements.limitation: Static boundary execution recorded separately; startup of realtime missing at baseline.

requirements.text: Once a booking or order is confirmed to the customer, it shall be persisted in the database; no confirmed record shall be lost across a server restart.
requirements.limitation: Existing source is supporting coverage only; full planned acceptance remains pending.

requirements.text: The web interface shall render and function correctly in the latest two stable versions of Chrome, Firefox and Edge.
requirements.limitation: Existing source is supporting coverage only; full planned acceptance remains pending.

variants.description: Verify the system displays available tables for a valid date, time and party size (REQ-1)
variants.preconditions: Booking service is running; at least one table exists in the database
variants.steps:
1: Call the availability-check function with a date, time slot and party size
2: Inspect the list of tables returned
variants.expected: Function returns all tables with capacity >= 4 that have no existing booking overlapping 19:00 on 2026-10-21

variants.description: Verify the system returns no tables when none are free for the requested slot (REQ-1, negative)
variants.preconditions: All tables are already booked for the requested slot
variants.steps:
1: Call the availability-check function for a fully-booked date/time/party size
2: Inspect the returned list
variants.data: Date: 2026-10-21, Time: 19:00, Party size: 2 (slot fully booked)
variants.expected: Function returns an empty list and the system suggests the closest available slot

variants.description: Verify creating a booking locks the selected table for its reserved slot (REQ-2)
variants.preconditions: Table 5 is free for the target slot
variants.steps:
1: Submit a booking request for Table 5 at a given date/time
2: Query the table's status immediately after
variants.expected: Booking record is created and Table 5's status is 'Reserved' for that slot

variants.description: Verify a booking cannot be created for a table already locked in an overlapping slot (REQ-2, negative)
variants.preconditions: Table 5 already has a confirmed booking for 19:00-20:30
variants.steps:
1: Submit a second booking request for Table 5 at 19:30 on the same date
2: Observe the system response
variants.expected: Booking request is rejected with a message indicating the table is unavailable for that slot

variants.description: Verify a booking can be cancelled more than 30 minutes before the reserved time (REQ-3)
variants.preconditions: A confirmed booking exists for a slot more than 30 minutes away
variants.steps:
1: Submit a cancellation request for the booking
2: Query the booking status and table status
variants.data: Booking reserved for 19:00; cancellation submitted at 18:00
variants.expected: Booking status changes to 'Cancelled' and the table is released back into the available pool

variants.description: Verify an admin can create a new menu item with valid name, price and category (REQ-5)
variants.preconditions: Admin is authenticated
variants.steps:
1: Submit a create-menu-item request with valid name, price, category and availability
2: Query the menu items table for the new entry
variants.data: Name: 'Paneer Tikka', Price: 220, Category: 'Starters', Available: true
variants.expected: Menu item is created successfully and appears in the menu items table with the given values

variants.description: Verify menu item creation is rejected when the price is negative or a required field is missing (REQ-5, negative)
variants.preconditions: Admin is authenticated
variants.steps:
1: Submit a create-menu-item request with a negative price and a missing name
2: Observe the system response
variants.expected: Request is rejected with a validation error identifying the invalid/missing fields; no record is created

variants.description: Verify an admin can update an existing menu item's details (REQ-5)
variants.preconditions: Menu item 'Paneer Tikka' already exists
variants.steps:
1: Submit an update request changing the item's price and availability
2: Query the menu items table for the updated entry
variants.data: Item: 'Paneer Tikka', New price: 240, Available: false
variants.expected: Menu item record is updated with the new price and availability status

variants.description: Verify an admin can delete a menu item (REQ-5)
variants.preconditions: Menu item 'Paneer Tikka' exists and is not referenced by an open order
variants.steps:
1: Submit a delete request for the menu item
2: Query the menu items table
variants.expected: Menu item is removed from the menu items table and no longer returned by menu queries

variants.description: Verify only menu items marked 'available' are returned by the menu listing function (REQ-6)
variants.preconditions: Menu contains a mix of available and unavailable items
variants.steps:
1: Call the menu-listing function
2: Inspect the returned list of items
variants.data: 5 items marked available, 2 items marked unavailable
variants.expected: Only the 5 available items are returned; the 2 unavailable items are excluded

variants.description: Verify menu items are grouped correctly by category (REQ-7)
variants.preconditions: Menu contains items across Starters, Main Course and Desserts categories
variants.steps:
1: Call the menu-listing function with grouping enabled
2: Inspect the grouped output
variants.expected: Items are grouped under their correct category headings with correct counts in each group

variants.description: Verify a customer can add one or more available menu items to the cart (REQ-8)
variants.preconditions: At least 2 menu items are marked available
variants.steps:
1: Add 'Paneer Tikka' to the cart
2: Add 'Spring Rolls' to the cart
3: Inspect the cart contents
variants.expected: Cart contains both items with the correct quantities

variants.description: Verify submitting a cart creates a single order with status 'Received' (REQ-8, REQ-9)
variants.preconditions: Cart contains at least one available item
variants.steps:
1: Submit the cart as an order
2: Query the orders table for the new record
variants.expected: A single order record is created containing both items with status 'Received'

variants.description: Verify staff can update an order's status from Received to Preparing to Served (REQ-9)
variants.preconditions: An order exists with status 'Received'
variants.steps:
1: Staff updates the order status to 'Preparing'
2: Staff updates the order status to 'Served'
3: Query the order's status after each update
variants.expected: Order status changes to 'Preparing' and then to 'Served' as each update is applied

variants.description: Verify an order is rejected if it contains a menu item marked unavailable, with correct notification (REQ-11, negative)
variants.preconditions: One item in the cart has been marked unavailable after being added
variants.steps:
1: Add an item to the cart while it is available
2: Admin marks the item unavailable
3: Submit the cart as an order
variants.data: Cart contains 'Spring Rolls', which is then marked unavailable
variants.expected: Order submission fails; customer is notified that 'Spring Rolls' is no longer available and was removed

variants.description: Verify the cart correctly calculates the total price for multiple items and quantities (REQ-8)
variants.preconditions: Menu item prices are known
variants.steps:
1: Add Paneer Tikka (price 220) x1 and Spring Rolls (price 180) x2 to the cart
2: Inspect the cart's calculated total
variants.data: Paneer Tikka x1 (220), Spring Rolls x2 (180 each)
variants.expected: Cart total is correctly calculated as 220 + (180 x 2) = 580

variants.description: Verify a new customer can register with a valid email/phone and password (REQ-12)
variants.preconditions: The email/phone used is not already registered
variants.steps:
1: Submit the registration form with a valid email and password
2: Query the Users table for the new account
variants.expected: A new user account is created with role 'Customer' and the password is stored hashed, not in plain text

variants.description: Verify registration is rejected for an email that is already registered (REQ-12, negative)
variants.preconditions: An account with the same email already exists
variants.steps:
1: Submit the registration form with an email that is already registered
2: Observe the system response
variants.expected: Registration is rejected with a validation error indicating the email is already in use

variants.description: Verify passwords are stored using a secure salted hash and never in plain text (REQ-12, SEC-1)
variants.preconditions: A user account has just been created
variants.steps:
1: Register a new user
2: Inspect the stored password value directly in the database
variants.expected: The stored value is a hashed string (e.g., PBKDF2/Argon2 format); the plain-text password is not present

variants.description: Verify a logged-in user's session/token is invalidated after 30 minutes of inactivity (REQ-14, SEC-8)
variants.preconditions: User is logged in and holds a valid session/token
variants.steps:
1: Log in and note the issued session/token
2: Remain inactive for 30 minutes (test clock or reduced timeout in the test environment)
3: Attempt to access a protected page using the same token
variants.expected: The session/token is rejected as expired/invalid and the user is prompted to log in again

variants.description: Verify a logged-in user's session/token is invalidated after 30 minutes of inactivity (REQ-14, SEC-8)
variants.preconditions: User is logged in and holds a valid session/token
variants.steps:
1: Log in and note the issued session/token
2: Remain inactive for 31 minutes
3: Attempt to access a protected page using the same token
variants.expected: The session/token is rejected as expired/invalid (401 Unauthorized) and the user is prompted to log in again

variants.description: Verify a booking cannot be cancelled less than 30 minutes before the reserved time (REQ-3, negative)
variants.preconditions: A confirmed booking exists for 19:00
variants.steps:
1: Submit a cancellation request at 18:45
2: Query the booking and table status
variants.data: Booking reserved for 19:00; cancellation submitted at 18:45
variants.expected: Cancellation is rejected with a message that bookings can be cancelled only up to 30 minutes before the reserved time; booking status remains 'Confirmed' and the table stays reserved

variants.description: Verify a booking cannot be cancelled less than 30 minutes before the reserved time (REQ-3, negative)
variants.preconditions: A confirmed booking exists for a slot less than 30 minutes away
variants.steps:
1: Submit a cancellation request for the booking
2: Query the booking status and table status
variants.data: Booking reserved for 19:00; cancellation submitted at 18:45
variants.expected: Cancellation request is rejected with a message that a booking can only be cancelled up to 30 minutes before the reserved time; booking status remains 'Confirmed' and the table stays reserved

tests.reconciliation: Additional revision refines the same ID; original scope retained where broader. No additional pass counted.

variants.description: Verify registration is rejected when the password is shorter than 8 characters (REQ-12, negative)
variants.preconditions: The email/phone used is not already registered
variants.steps:
1: Submit the registration form with a valid email and a 7-character password
2: Observe the system response
3: Query the Users table
variants.expected: Registration is rejected with a validation error stating the minimum length of 8 characters; no account is created

variants.description: Verify a booking can be cancelled exactly 30 minutes before the reserved time (REQ-3, boundary)
variants.preconditions: A confirmed booking exists for 19:00
variants.steps:
1: Submit a cancellation request at exactly 18:30
2: Query the booking status and table status
variants.data: Booking reserved for 19:00; cancellation submitted at 18:30
variants.expected: Cancellation is accepted; booking status changes to 'Cancelled' and the table is released back into the available pool

variants.description: Verify the booking API persists a new booking to the database and updates table status (REQ-1, REQ-2)
variants.preconditions: Booking API and database are both running and reachable
variants.steps:
1: Send a POST request to the booking endpoint with valid date/time/party size/table
2: Query the database directly for the new booking record
3: Query the table's status in the database
variants.expected: API returns 201 Created; a matching row exists in the Bookings table; Table 5's status is 'Reserved'

variants.description: Verify the staff dashboard retrieves and displays current bookings from the booking service (REQ-4)
variants.preconditions: At least 3 bookings exist for the current day; staff user is logged in
variants.steps:
1: Log in as a Staff user
2: Open the Bookings section of the admin dashboard
3: Compare the list shown against the database records
variants.data: Staff credentials; 3 seeded bookings for today
variants.expected: All 3 bookings are listed on the dashboard with correct table, time and customer details

variants.description: Verify staff can manually cancel a booking from the dashboard and the change reflects in the database (REQ-4)
variants.preconditions: A confirmed booking exists; staff user is logged in
variants.steps:
1: Log in as Staff
2: Open the booking in the dashboard and select 'Cancel Booking'
3: Query the database for the booking's status
variants.expected: Dashboard shows the booking as 'Cancelled'; database record for BK-1001 has status 'Cancelled'

variants.description: Verify a menu update made via the admin panel is immediately reflected in the customer-facing menu API (REQ-5, REQ-6)
variants.preconditions: Admin is logged in; customer-facing menu API is reachable
variants.steps:
1: Update an existing item's price via the admin panel
2: Call the customer-facing menu API for the same item
variants.expected: Customer-facing API returns the item with the updated price of 250, with no manual refresh needed

variants.description: Verify marking an item unavailable removes it from the customer menu listing returned by the API (REQ-6)
variants.preconditions: Item is currently available and visible to customers
variants.steps:
1: Mark the item as unavailable via the admin panel
2: Call the customer-facing menu listing API
variants.expected: The item no longer appears in the customer-facing menu API response

variants.description: Verify an order-status change in the backend triggers a WebSocket push event to the Node.js real-time service (REQ-10)
variants.preconditions: Node.js WebSocket service is running and connected to the Django backend
variants.steps:
1: Update an order's status via the staff dashboard
2: Inspect the WebSocket event emitted by the Node.js service
variants.expected: A WebSocket event is emitted containing the order ID and the new status 'Preparing'

variants.description: Verify the customer's order-tracking screen updates in real time upon receiving a WebSocket status push (REQ-10)
variants.preconditions: Customer's order-tracking page is open with an active WebSocket connection
variants.steps:
1: Trigger an order-status update on the backend
2: Observe the customer's order-tracking screen without refreshing
variants.expected: The order-tracking screen updates to show 'Preparing' within 1 second, with no manual refresh

variants.description: Verify the customer's order-tracking screen updates in real time upon receiving WebSocket status pushes, with at least 95% of updates within 1 second (REQ-10, PERF-2)
variants.preconditions: Customer's order-tracking page is open with an active WebSocket connection for each of 20 orders with status 'Received'
variants.steps:
1: Trigger an order-status update on the backend for each of the 20 orders
2: Record the time each status change is saved and the time the tracking screen shows the new status, without refreshing
3: Calculate the delay for each update
4: Count the updates with a delay of 1 second or less
variants.data: Order IDs: OR-2001 to OR-2020, status change: 'Received' -> 'Preparing'
variants.expected: Each order-tracking screen updates to show 'Preparing' with no manual refresh; at least 19 of the 20 updates (95%) appear within 1 second of the status change being saved

variants.description: Verify order submission correctly persists the order and order items in the database with correct totals (REQ-8)
variants.preconditions: Cart contains valid available items
variants.steps:
1: Submit the cart as an order
2: Query the Orders and OrderItems tables
variants.data: Cart: Paneer Tikka x1, Spring Rolls x2
variants.expected: Orders table has one new row; OrderItems table has two rows linked to it; total amount matches cart total

variants.description: Verify an Admin-role user can access menu-management endpoints while a Customer-role user is denied (REQ-13)
variants.preconditions: One Admin account and one Customer account exist
variants.steps:
1: Log in as Admin and call the menu-management endpoint
2: Log in as Customer and call the same endpoint
variants.expected: Admin request succeeds (200 OK); Customer request is denied (403 Forbidden)

variants.description: Verify login issues a valid session/token that is accepted by protected API endpoints (REQ-12, REQ-13)
variants.preconditions: A registered user account exists
variants.steps:
1: Log in with valid credentials and capture the issued token
2: Call a protected endpoint using that token
variants.expected: Login succeeds and returns a valid token; the protected endpoint accepts the token and returns the expected data

variants.description: End-to-end: customer books a table via the UI; available tables are shown within 2 seconds and a confirmation with a booking reference is displayed (REQ-1, REQ-2)
variants.preconditions: Customer is on the Table Booking page; at least one table is free for the chosen slot
variants.steps:
1: Select a date, time and party size
2: Choose a table from the available options and confirm
3: Observe the confirmation screen
variants.expected: Available tables are displayed within 2 seconds of the request; booking is confirmed and a unique booking reference number is displayed to the customer

variants.description: End-to-end: customer attempts to double-book an already reserved slot; system rejects and suggests the nearest available slot (REQ-1, REQ-2)
variants.preconditions: The chosen table/slot combination is already fully booked
variants.steps:
1: Select a date, time and party size that is already fully booked
2: Attempt to confirm the booking
3: Observe the system's response
variants.data: Date: 2026-10-22, Time: 20:00 (already fully booked), Party size: 3
variants.expected: Booking is rejected with a message, and the system suggests the closest available time slot; the availability response is displayed within 2 seconds

variants.description: End-to-end: admin adds a new Starters item; customer browsing the menu sees it under Starters (REQ-5, REQ-7)
variants.preconditions: Admin is logged in; customer has the menu page open
variants.steps:
1: Admin adds a new item 'Spring Rolls' under category Starters
2: Customer refreshes/browses the menu page
3: Customer looks under the Starters category
variants.expected: 'Spring Rolls' appears under the Starters category on the customer-facing menu

variants.description: End-to-end: admin marks an item unavailable; customer no longer sees it while browsing the live menu (REQ-6)
variants.preconditions: Item is currently visible to the customer
variants.steps:
1: Admin marks the item as unavailable
2: Customer browses/refreshes the menu page
variants.expected: 'Spring Rolls' no longer appears on the customer-facing menu

variants.description: End-to-end: customer places an order, staff updates status through all stages, customer sees live updates within 1 second of each change (REQ-8, REQ-9, REQ-10, PERF-2)
variants.preconditions: Customer has items in the cart; staff dashboard is open
variants.steps:
1: Customer submits the order
2: Staff updates status to 'Preparing', then 'Served'
3: Customer observes their order-tracking screen throughout
variants.data: Cart: Paneer Tikka x1, Spring Rolls x2
variants.expected: Customer's screen updates live through Received -> Preparing -> Served without any page refresh, each update appearing within 1 second of the status change being saved

variants.description: End-to-end: customer attempts to order an item that becomes unavailable after adding it to the cart (REQ-11)
variants.preconditions: Item is available when added to the cart
variants.steps:
1: Customer adds 'Spring Rolls' to the cart
2: Admin marks 'Spring Rolls' unavailable before checkout
3: Customer submits the order
variants.data: Cart: Spring Rolls x2, marked unavailable before submission
variants.expected: Order submission is blocked and the customer is notified that 'Spring Rolls' was removed as unavailable

variants.description: End-to-end: customer registers, logs in, and books a table using their authenticated session (REQ-12)
variants.preconditions: Email used for registration is not already registered
variants.steps:
1: Register a new customer account
2: Log in with the new account
3: Use the authenticated session to book a table
variants.expected: Registration, login and booking all succeed, with the booking correctly associated with the new account

variants.description: End-to-end: a Staff-role user attempts to access an Admin-only menu-management page and is denied access (REQ-13)
variants.preconditions: A Staff account exists and is logged in
variants.steps:
1: Log in as Staff
2: Navigate directly to the Admin-only menu-management page
variants.expected: Access is denied with HTTP 403 Forbidden and an appropriate message; the menu-management page is not displayed

variants.description: End-to-end: staff creates a booking for a walk-in customer from the dashboard and cancels it more than 30 minutes ahead (REQ-3, REQ-4)
variants.preconditions: Staff user is logged in; Table 3 is free for the slot
variants.steps:
1: Log in as Staff
2: Create a booking for Table 3 via the dashboard
3: Verify it appears in the booking list
4: Cancel it from the dashboard
variants.expected: Booking is created and listed as 'Confirmed'; after cancellation it shows 'Cancelled' and Table 3 is available again for that slot

variants.description: End-to-end: customer cancels a booking more than 30 minutes before the reserved time; staff finds it in the dashboard, sees the table released and manually creates a new booking for that slot (REQ-3, REQ-4)
variants.preconditions: Customer has a confirmed booking for a slot more than 30 minutes away; Staff account exists
variants.steps:
1: Customer logs in and cancels the booking
2: Log in as Staff and search for the booking in the admin dashboard
3: Check the status shown for the booking
4: Manually create a new booking for the same table and slot on behalf of a customer
5: Check that the new booking is listed in the dashboard
variants.data: Existing booking ID: BK-1002 (Table 5, 2026-10-25, 19:00), cancelled at 17:00; Staff credentials; New booking: Table 5, 2026-10-25, 19:00, Party size: 2
variants.expected: Customer sees BK-1002 as 'Cancelled'; staff search returns BK-1002 with status 'Cancelled'; Table 5 can be booked again for 19:00; the manual booking is created and listed in the dashboard

tests.reconciliation: Additional revision refines the same ID; original scope retained where broader. No additional pass counted.

variants.description: Load test: 50 concurrent users browse the menu, book tables and place orders (PERF-1, PERF-3)
variants.preconditions: System deployed on the test server with seeded data; load tool (Locust/JMeter) configured
variants.steps:
1: Ramp up to 50 virtual users over 1 minute
2: Each user browses the menu, checks availability and places an order
3: Run for 10 minutes
4: Collect response-time and error statistics
variants.expected: At least 95% of page loads/API responses complete within 2 s; HTTP 5xx error rate is 1% or less

variants.description: Performance: system under 50 concurrent users meets the response-time and error-rate limits (PERF-1, PERF-3)
variants.preconditions: System is deployed on the test server with PostgreSQL; menu items, tables and bookings are seeded; a load-testing tool is available
variants.steps:
1: Start 50 virtual users at the same time
2: Each user repeatedly browses the menu, checks table availability and places an order for the whole test period
3: Record the response time of every page load and REST API request
4: Count the HTTP 5xx responses
5: Calculate the percentage of responses within 2 seconds and the percentage of HTTP 5xx responses
